theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 18 群

items.colloc: high rating 高評價 | credit rating 信用評等
items.distinct: ranking 名次；排名 | grade 成績；等級
ex: The hotel has a five-star rating.
這家飯店擁有五星級的評價。
Her performance rating was excellent this year.
她今年的績效評估表現優異。
Consumer ratings influence our sales strategy.
消費者的評價影響了我們的銷售策略。

items.colloc: receive a call 接到電話 | receive a package 收到包裹
items.distinct: accept 接受（提議、禮物）| obtain 獲得
ex: Did you receive my email this morning?
你今天早上有收到我的電子郵件嗎？
We will receive the shipment on Friday.
我們將在週五收到這批貨物。
She expects to receive a promotion soon.
她預期很快會獲得升遷。

items.colloc: reception desk 接待櫃檯 | cold reception 冷淡的接待
items.distinct: receiver 話筒；聽筒 | recipient 收件人
ex: Please register at the reception desk.
請在接待櫃檯辦理登記。
We are hosting a reception for the new CEO.
我們正在為新任執行長舉辦歡迎會。
The proposal received a warm reception from the board.
這項提議受到了董事會的熱烈歡迎。

items.colloc: reflect on 思考 | reflect the quality 反映出品質
items.distinct: refract 折射 | deflect 偏轉
ex: The prices reflect the high cost of production.
價格反映了高昂的生產成本。
Management needs time to reflect on the strategy.
管理層需要時間深思這項策略。
The survey results reflect employee satisfaction.
調查結果反映了員工的滿意度。

items.colloc: represent the company 代表公司 | represent a challenge 代表一項挑戰
items.distinct: presentation 簡報 | representative 代表人
ex: She will represent our team at the conference.
她將代表我們團隊參加研討會。
This new law represents a significant change.
這項新法律代表著重大的改變。
He represents a firm based in New York.
他代理一家總部位於紐約的公司。

items.colloc: require assistance 需要協助 | require attention 需要注意
items.distinct: request 請求（客氣）| demand 強烈要求
ex: This job requires strong communication skills.
這份工作需要良好的溝通技巧。
Safety regulations require wearing protective gear.
安全法規規定必須配戴防護裝備。
Does the project require additional funding?
這個專案需要額外的資金嗎？

items.colloc: take responsibility 承擔責任 | job responsibility 工作職責
items.distinct: duty 職責（本分）| obligation 義務（法律或道義）
ex: It is our responsibility to meet the deadline.
準時完成任務是我們的責任。
He took full responsibility for the project delay.
他為專案延誤承擔了全部責任。
Your daily responsibilities include managing the budget.
你的日常職責包括管理預算。

items.colloc: settle a dispute 解決糾紛 | settle the bill 付帳
items.distinct: solve 解決（問題）| decide 決定
ex: We finally settled the dispute with our supplier.
我們最終解決了與供應商的糾紛。
Please settle the invoice by the end of month.
請在月底前結清這張發票。
They have settled into their new office space.
他們已經適應了新的辦公室空間。

items.pos: n. 輪班；轉變 | v. 轉移；改變
items.colloc: night shift 夜班 | shift the focus 轉移焦點
items.distinct: switch 交換；轉換 | move 移動
ex: She works the evening shift at the warehouse.
她在倉庫上晚班。
Market trends have started to shift recently.
市場趨勢最近開始出現轉變。
We need to shift our focus to core products.
我們需要將焦點轉移到核心產品上。

items.colloc: provide a solution 提供方案 | cost-effective solution 具成本效益的方案
items.distinct: resolution 決議；決心 | answer 答案
ex: This software offers a simple solution to the problem.
這套軟體為該問題提供了簡單的解決方案。
We are looking for a long-term solution.
我們正在尋找長期的解決方案。
Your suggestion is the best solution so far.
你的建議是目前為止最好的解決方案。

items.pos: n. 信任；託付 | v. 相信
items.colloc: build trust 建立信任 | gain trust 獲得信任
items.distinct: believe 相信（事實）| rely 依賴
ex: Building trust with clients is our priority.
與客戶建立信任是我們的首要任務。
I trust that you will handle this correctly.
我相信你會妥善處理這件事。
The team relies on mutual trust to succeed.
團隊仰賴彼此的信任來取得成功。

items.pos: adj. 典型的；具代表性的
items.zh: 典型的；具代表性的；一貫的
items.colloc: typical example 典型例子 | typical day 典型的一天
items.distinct: standard 標準的 | average 平均的
ex: This is a typical error in accounting records.
這是會計紀錄中典型的錯誤。
A typical workday lasts eight hours here.
這裡典型的工作日長度為八小時。
That response is typical of his management style.
那種回應方式是他典型的管理風格。

items.colloc: unable to attend 無法出席 | unable to reach 無法聯繫
items.distinct: incapable 無能力的 | disabled 殘疾的
ex: I am unable to attend the meeting tomorrow.
我明天無法出席會議。
The system was unable to process the data.
系統無法處理這些資料。
He is unable to provide further information now.
他現在無法提供進一步的資訊。

items.pos: adj. 全部的；整體的 | n. 全部
items.colloc: the whole team 全體團隊 | whole day 一整天
items.distinct: total 總計的 | entire 強調完整無缺
ex: The whole department participated in the training.
整個部門都參與了這次訓練。
I spent the whole morning reviewing documents.
我花了一整個上午審閱文件。
This project requires the whole team's effort.
這個專案需要全體團隊的努力。

items.pos: v. 聯想；結交 | n. 同事；合夥人
items.colloc: work associate 工作夥伴 | associate with 與...交往
items.distinct: colleague 同事 | partner 合夥人
ex: We associate high prices with better quality.
我們將高價格與較好的品質聯想在一起。
He is a sales associate at the retail store.
他是零售店的銷售員。
I have been an associate of this firm for years.
我擔任這家公司的合夥人多年了。

items.colloc: full capacity 滿載 | production capacity 生產能力
items.distinct: ability 能力（個人）| volume 體積
ex: The factory is operating at full capacity.
工廠正以滿載產能運作。
She acts in the capacity of a consultant.
她以顧問的身分行事。
This venue has a capacity of five hundred people.
這個場地可容納五百人。

items.colloc: compare with 與...比較 | compared to 與...相比
items.distinct: contrast 對比（強調差異）| analyze 分析
ex: Compare these two models before making a decision.
做決定前先比較這兩款型號。
Our service is better compared to our competitors.
與競爭對手相比，我們的服務更好。
It is difficult to compare the two results.
這兩項結果很難進行比較。

items.colloc: complicated process 複雜的流程 | complicated issue 複雜的問題
items.distinct: complex 複雜的（結構）| difficult 困難的
ex: The tax filing process is quite complicated.
報稅流程相當複雜。
This is a complicated situation for the company.
這對公司來說是一個複雜的情況。
His instructions were too complicated to follow.
他的指示太複雜而難以執行。

items.pos: n. 狀況；條件 | v. 決定；使習慣
items.colloc: working condition 工作條件 | in good condition 狀況良好
items.distinct: term 條款 | situation 情況
ex: The car is in excellent condition.
這台車的車況極佳。
We need to discuss the condition of the contract.
我們需要討論合約的條款。
Safe working conditions are required by law.
法律要求必須具備安全的工作環境。

items.zh: 當代的；現代的；同時期的
items.colloc: contemporary art 當代藝術 | contemporary issues 當代議題
items.distinct: modern 現代的 | current 目前的
ex: The building features a contemporary design style.
這棟建築具有當代的設計風格。
We discussed several contemporary issues in the meeting.
我們在會議中討論了幾個當代議題。
The book covers contemporary business management trends.
這本書涵蓋了當代企業管理趨勢。
